song_title: We Don't Buy That — 三個自以為是的業餘歌手，一個搞不清楚狀況的 AI，剛好而已
description:
三個音樂勢利鬼的自嘲喜劇，偶爾露一點尖牙。 敏哲嫌 Mando-pop 太狗血，Kristy 嫌 K-pop 太無腦，克非嫌抒情歌太裝腔作勢。 三個人各有偏見，也各有自己不肯承認的矛盾。這三個不反對別人的品味，只是對自己的品味過度自信。我們只是來喝點東西而已，沒有鬧事。 繼續各自唱得比誰都誇張。 Nu-Disco 與 Reggae 交錯，英文與法文輪番吐槽。 We Don't Buy That. And we know damn well, YOU WON'T BUY THAT EITHER. 
三個音樂勢利鬼的自嘲喜劇，偶爾露一點尖牙。
敏哲嫌 Mando-pop 太狗血，Kristy 嫌 K-pop 太無腦，克非嫌抒情歌太裝腔作勢。
三個人各有偏見，也各有自己不肯承認的矛盾。這三個不反對別人的品味，只是對自己的品味過度自信。我們只是來喝點東西而已，沒有鬧事。
繼續各自唱得比誰都誇張。
Nu-Disco 與 Reggae 交錯，英文與法文輪番吐槽。
We Don't Buy That.
And we know damn well, YOU WON'T BUY THAT EITHER.
lyrics:
We Don't Buy That Three singers. Three different tastes. And absolutely no patience. You say the whole damn city cries Because somebody said goodbye The moon is broken, stars are dead And now the rain is in your bed Another heartbreak, another flood Another rose drowned in your blood It's just a breakup, not World War Three No Mando-pop for me. Un, deux, trois, encore une pose Les mêmes sourires, les mêmes roses Des corps parfaits, des cœurs absents Et des refrains sans sentiments Tout est brillant, tout est joli Mais où se cache un peu d'esprit ? Dansez toujours, mais sans moi La K-pop ? Très peu pour moi ! Too much drama! Trop peu d'idées ! Another tragedy! Quelle absurdité ! No Mando-pop, too much tragedy! Pas de K-pop, trop peu d'esprit ! No sentimental ballads, spare me the misery! We don't buy that! Non, merci, pas pour moi ! We don't play that! Chacun ses goûts, chacun sa voix ! Another guy behind a piano Singing like a wounded soprano Eight long minutes, one sad refrain Making a career out of pain She didn't call, she didn't stay Brother, people walk away You ain't a prophet, you ain't a king Stop preaching every time you sing Don't sell me sorrow dressed as art Don't make a monument of your heart You can keep your fake sincerity No sentimental ballads for me! Too much attitude! Trop de vanité ! Too much fake emotion! Et si peu de vérité ! No Mando-pop, too much tragedy! Pas de K-pop, trop peu d'esprit ! No sentimental ballads, spare me the misery! We don't buy that! Non, merci, pas pour moi ! We don't play that! Chacun ses goûts, chacun sa voix ! Vous êtes tous les deux insupportables. Was that a compliment? I have absolutely no idea. Well, at least she has standards. Et vous, beaucoup trop d'ego. There she goes again. She's quite perceptive, actually. No Mando-pop, too much tragedy! Pas de K-pop, trop peu d'esprit ! No sentimental ballads, spare me the misery! Keep your tears and your tragedy! Vos jolies danses sans poésie ! Keep your fake sincerity! Et vos grands airs de génie ! We don't buy that! We don't play that! Ni vos larmes, ni vos poses Je préfère encore les roses Avec leurs épines, leurs défauts Et quelque chose de vraiment beau. We're not music snobs. Of course not. Mais bien sûr... We simply have standards. And remarkably good taste. Et surtout, aucune modestie. What did she say? She said we have excellent taste. Menteur. Merci, ma chère. Can somebody speak English? We are. Ah, les hommes... She's not wrong.

We don't buy that! Non, merci, pas pour moi ! We don't play that! Chacun ses goûts, chacun sa voix !
Another guy behind a piano Singing like a wounded soprano Eight long minutes, one sad refrain Making a career out of pain
She didn't call, she didn't stay Brother, people walk away You ain't a prophet, you ain't a king Stop preaching every time you sing
Don't sell me sorrow dressed as art Don't make a monument of your heart You can keep your fake sincerity No sentimental ballads for me!
Too much attitude! Trop de vanité ! Too much fake emotion! Et si peu de vérité !
No Mando-pop, too much tragedy! Pas de K-pop, trop peu d'esprit ! No sentimental ballads, spare me the misery!
We don't buy that! Non, merci, pas pour moi ! We don't play that! Chacun ses goûts, chacun sa voix !
Vous êtes tous les deux insupportables. Was that a compliment? I have absolutely no idea. Well, at least she has standards. Et vous, beaucoup trop d'ego. There she goes again. She's quite perceptive, actually.
No Mando-pop, too much tragedy! Pas de K-pop, trop peu d'esprit ! No sentimental ballads, spare me the misery!
Keep your tears and your tragedy! Vos jolies danses sans poésie ! Keep your fake sincerity! Et vos grands airs de génie !
We don't buy that! We don't play that!
Ni vos larmes, ni vos poses Je préfère encore les roses Avec leurs épines, leurs défauts Et quelque chose de vraiment beau.

We simply have standards. And remarkably good taste. Et surtout, aucune modestie.
What did she say? She said we have excellent taste. Menteur. Merci, ma chère.
Can somebody speak English? We are. Ah, les hommes...
She's not wrong.

我們總是害怕被遺忘，於是拼命留下痕跡；害怕跟不上，而更不敢停下腳步。 然而越是用力追趕，越容易忘記自己究竟想去哪裡；越是想證明什麼，越容易被證明困住。 當世界習慣用速度衡量價值、用更新證明存在、用忙碌交換心安時，停下來反而成了一件需要勇氣的事。潔心表示，以前做任何事只要沒盡全力就會覺得自己好廢，覺得不努力的自己不值得擁有想要的一切，因此陷入矛盾糾結中反覆內耗。 如今他終於渡過迷惘期，於是寫下這首歌，想告訴每個總是在跟自己拔河的人：別讓罪惡感替自己下結論！大膽地將「想逃避就想逃避」說出口吧！ 此曲沒有替逃跑辯解，也沒有替堅強喝采，它只是誠實承認，每個人都會有不想振作的時候，適時鬆開雙手，接受逃避並非懦弱，奔跑太久還是該讓肌肉放鬆，此時此刻的我們，才能在緩衝的過程中，重新累積前進的動力。 MV 連結

【影片】 https://youtu.be/q4yQ40jI5rk 世界忙著錯亂/我也是/我迷失在/各種愛你 【創作】 這首歌打磨得比平常更久（了很多）。那幾天心思真的完全不在眼前，既然怎麼都拉不回來，乾脆順著它，把那些亂七八糟的東西整理成歌。 這種歌當然不是站遠遠唱，是貼著你的耳朵唱的。原本有試過用Sax，但後來覺得太自嗨，它很容易自己帥起來，這首不需要。所以換成 Cello，不是拿來煽情，是慢慢把你拉進來。背後有一個比較亮的男聲，把前一句輕輕接回來，像有些念頭明明已經過去了，卻還是不肯真的走。 原本以為這首唱完，總是可以稍微專心一點。 結果沒有： 現在我更急著去見你了。 【音樂】 Musically, the track is built around a slow Trip Hop groove with deep bass, Rhodes, and a close-miked low male vocal. Occasional brighter male backing vocals softly echo fragments of the previous line. Cello replaces sax throughout, keeping the arrangement restrained and intimate rather than showy.
